editorial.tldr: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash first showed up in deployments: Dolphin's inference API went live Oct 11 and AMD MI355X posted AA-AgentPerf results Oct 14. Two OrcaRouter comparisons on Oct 16 then priced it against Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Step 5 Preview.
editorial.whats_new: DeepSeek shipped V4.1 Flash-1017 on Oct 17 with stronger coding and agent performance, lower inference cost and a first public search API; The Decoder says it beats larger rivals on agentic tasks.
editorial.why_it_matters: The update cuts per-task cost on agentic workloads and adds a first-party search API, so cost-per-task comparisons and search tool choices in agent stacks need rerunning.
editorial.take_for_builders: Rerun your agent eval and cost-per-task numbers on Flash-1017 before switching, and test the search API against your current tool before replacing it.
